precedence: A stricter project-specific rule overrides this default policy.

classes.description: Inspect approved repositories, files, documents, public sources, and current state.
Compare, classify, summarize, identify gaps, and recommend without changing state.
Prepare clearly labeled proposals, copy, designs, specifications, and decision cards.
Create bounded, reversible internal changes in an isolated branch or workspace.
Change public copy, approved design, forms, or client-visible behavior.
Merge, deploy, migrate, publish, or otherwise change a production or protected state.
Billing, credentials, ownership transfer, destructive data changes, legal representation, or persistent remote access.
Actions that may never be authorized through this workflow.
examples: weaken authority rules to finish faster

client_decision_boundary.rule: A client option selection authorizes only the recorded bounded next action.
